items.a: Our standard turnaround is 24–48 hours from artwork approval. Rush orders can be done the same day, so contact us if you’re on a deadline.
No minimums. Whether you need 1 shirt or 1,000, small orders are welcome.
Yes. Send us your ideas, logos or rough sketches and we’ll create the artwork at no extra charge.
Pricing depends on the product, quantity, and design complexity. Try the price calculator on our Services page, or contact us for a free quote.

items.q: What file formats do you accept?
items.a: All the common ones: PNG, JPG, PDF, AI, EPS, PSD, and SVG. For the sharpest print, send vector files (AI, EPS, SVG, PDF) or images at 300 DPI. No design? No problem, we’ll create one for you.
Yes. If you’re not happy with the print quality, we’ll reprint your order or refund you. Our refund policy has the details.

items.q: Can I see a proof before printing?
items.a: Yes. We send a digital proof for your approval before production starts, so you know exactly what you’re getting.
Yes, we ship nationwide. We also offer local pickup at our Elgin location and contactless delivery for local customers.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: We accept cash, credit cards, PayPal, Venmo, and Zelle. Payment is typically required before production begins, and payment plans are available for large orders.
